defaultDescription.zh-CN: 专为首次上雪成人设计，含3晚北大湖山居滑进滑出住宿、3天全天雪票全套雪具租赁及12小时1对4持证教练分级课，结营稳步滑行中长距离绿道。
defaultDescription.en: Built for first-time adult skiers, bundling 3 nights at Beidahu Shanju Ski-In Lodge, 3-day lift passes with full rental gear, and 12 hours of 1:4 certified coaching toward confident green-run cruising.
